facts.fact: At an ONECI workshop on 26 February 2026 the director general named law L/2023/0019 on the identification of physical persons, and the elections director general said Guinea now has two new laws, on identification and on civil status, being disseminated; the document gives no promulgation date and the date is that of the workshop.
facts.system: Loi L/2023/0019 portant identification des personnes physiques (2023)

systems.tiers: national; deployment still facing logistical and human challenges
